title: Exact-head CI recovery and Production promotion ratchet parity

phases.objective: Keep canonical CI and exact-head recovery fail-closed while evaluating governed Production promotions against the classifier-approved first-parent phase base and ordinary pull requests against their declared base SHA.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request targets main or Production and triggers .github/workflows/ci-pull-request-recovery.yml.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both workflows check out the exact candidate, classify pull requests targeting Production through the canonical promotion gate, evaluate Context Kernel changes against phase_evaluation_base, and retain ordinary pull-request base semantics without write, deployment, credential, provider, migration, database, or external-send authority.
steps: Trigger canonical CI and recovery for pull requests targeting main or Production.
For a Production-targeted pull request, invoke the canonical E2E promotion classifier with the exact head, head ref, base ref, and base SHA.
Fail closed unless the classifier emits a 40-character phase_evaluation_base for an allowed Production promotion identity.
Diff the Context Kernel ratchet against phase_evaluation_base for governed promotions and against the declared pull-request base SHA for ordinary pull requests.
Run the unchanged runtime hardcoding scanner, tests, runtime evidence, governance contracts, and stale-evidence rejection.
Preserve read-only workflow permissions and bounded test-progress artifacts.
assertions: Production promotion identity is not inferred from branch text alone.
The canonical e2e-parallel-pr-gate remains the authority for phase_evaluation_base.
Invalid Production candidates fail before the Context Kernel scanner rather than falling back to the Production base.
Ordinary pull requests still use github.event.pull_request.base.sha with three-dot diff semantics.
Both canonical CI and recovery use the same scope-selection logic and unchanged runtime scanner.
The workflows contain no write, deployment, credential, provider, SQL, Migration Apply, database mutation, or external-send authority.

phases.objective: Observe exact-head recovery workflow results across multiple same-repository pull-request lifecycle events while the canonical CI registration cause is diagnosed.
Retain fail-closed exact-SHA checkout, cross-repository rejection, non-cancelling evidence, and bounded diagnostics during runner or registration incidents.
Prove one Draft and one Ready pull-request cycle before considering the recovery workflow authoritative for temporary CI evidence.
Resolve or replace the canonical CI registration path without weakening protected-branch requirements or granting deployment authority.
